note: What a server sends to say what a seat is called, while the match is being put together.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which look the seat's champion wears. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: nameLength
fields.note: How many bytes the name below occupies, counting the byte that ends it.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What the seat is called. It is not padded.

fields.name: terminator
fields.note: A zero byte closing the text, which the length above counts.
